description: Where the test email landed at each seed mailbox. Poll about once a minute while status is waiting. placement is inbox, spam, promotions, social, updates or forums, missing while the email has not arrived, or unreadable while we could not read that seed mailbox; score is the inbox share from 0 to 10 once the test is completed, leaving unreadable seeds out. rspamd is the content filter verdict with its matched rules, when a seed reports one.
